inputs: A Fact, Hypothesis, Decision, ExperimentLearning or FailureLearning
A date, for every staleness question
A decision id and a reason, for a ledger transition
invariants: A Fact with no evidence raises and names Hypothesis; promote() is the only crossing and requires SUPPORTED status plus evidence (rule 16).
Ledger transitions change status and add a reason; they never rewrite why, evidence, alternatives, risks, reconsider_if or rollback.
store.add refuses to overwrite silently; the normal way to change a claim is a new record that supersedes the old one.
Flagging a permanent record raises - if an invariant needs revalidation, the freshness class was wrong.
Writes are sorted-key JSON, so two sessions produce byte-identical files and the store merges without conflict.
outputs: Stale and needing-revalidation work lists, ordered by due date then kind then id
Decision transitions: reconsidered, rolled back, superseded
purpose: Five sibling record types with no inheritance, four decay classes, and one directory of JSON files. A guess cannot be stored in the shape of a fact, and a claim that has gone stale can be found.
risks: No index and no semantic retrieval: every non-keyed question is a full sweep, which stops being free somewhere in the thousands of records.
contradictions() surfaces declared contradictions only; nothing detects two records that disagree in prose.
title: Company knowledge store
